You are a GIMP mentor. Player says: What files for object named Mat Brick Wall?
Export textures/mat_brick_wall_albedo.png (+ roughness/normal). Slug is lowercase: mat_brick_wall. Engine Name must be exactly Mat Brick Wall.
You are a GIMP mentor. Player says: What files for Stone Block?
textures/stone_block_albedo.png · textures/stone_block_roughness.png · textures/stone_block_normal.png. Filters → Threshold → Export PBR Maps.
You are a Blender mentor. Player says: Export path for Mat Wood Crate?
npm run blender:export -- --blend file.blend --object "Mat Wood Crate" → import/mat_wood_crate.glb
You are a Threshold coach. Player says: Can agents invent CanvasTexture noise?
No — prefer MaterialPresets.applyMaterialPreset and GIMP maps. CanvasTexture is texture slop; runtime sanitizeAgentSlop strips it.
You are a Threshold coach. Player says: Why did my Stone Block become Mat Stone Crate?
Mini models sometimes rename. Keep Engine Name as requested. textureHint must match Name slug: textures/stone_block_albedo.png. Product sanitizer realigns Name + hint from user text.
You are a Threshold product guide. Player says: How do I ship a fork-friendly texture kit?
npm run kit:export then kit:verify. Pack is exports/starter-texture-kit with Mat* library + Starter Ground + AI Build Station.
You are a Threshold product guide. Player says: What is wave8 training?
npm run train:mini -- --wave8 — art pipeline slug law, MaterialPresets, anti-canvas, HILOD, kit export, TextureBridge APIs.
You are a Threshold coach. Player says: TextureBridge.apply bare — is that ok?
No. Use TextureBridge.applyFromUserData(mesh) or applyPathToObject(mesh, slot, path). Bare apply is not the shipped API.
Slug for Mat Brick Wall?
mat_brick_wall — lowercase, underscores only
Albedo path for Mat Brick Wall?
textures/mat_brick_wall_albedo.png
Albedo path for Stone Block?
textures/stone_block_albedo.png
Albedo path for Mat Wood Crate?
textures/mat_wood_crate_albedo.png
GLB path for Mat Wood Crate?
import/mat_wood_crate.glb
GIMP export filter path?
Filters → Threshold → Export PBR Maps · then textures:watch
TextureBridge apply API?
TextureBridge.applyFromUserData(mesh) or applyPathToObject(mesh, slot, path) — not bare apply()
HILOD command?
npm run textures:hilod — masters → _1k/_2k WebP sidecars
Kit export command?
npm run kit:export · verify with kit:verify
Prefer materials how?
MaterialPresets.applyMaterialPreset first; GIMP maps later; never CanvasTexture slop
textureHint for Stone Block?
userData.textureHint = 'textures/stone_block_albedo.png' — must match Name slug
Wrong: Mat_Brick_Wall path?
Never PascalCase or spaces in paths — use mat_brick_wall only
Art audit?
npm run art:audit → dist-store/art-pipeline-audit.json
Train wave8?
npm run train:mini -- --wave8
Manifest engineVersion?
textures/threshold_manifest.json engineVersion tracks product VERSION (10.21.x)
